items_flat.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with longer scene extension and 4K upscaling
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash：場景延伸加長、支援 4K 升頻
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developer video generation and editing via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The update extends scenes using up to 10 seconds of prior context (versus 1 second previously), adds first/last-frame interpolation, 360p drafting, and upscaling to 1080p or 4K, with clips extendable in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds. It is rolling out in the Gemini app for paid subscribers, Flow, AI Studio, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，供開發者透過 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 做影片生成與編輯。新版可用最多 10 秒先前內容做場景延伸（先前僅 1 秒），並加入首尾幀插值、360p 草稿與 1080p／4K 升頻，每次延伸 10 秒、累計最長 40 秒。正於付費 Gemini 應用、Flow、AI Studio 與 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a controllability upgrade more than a new flagship: longer temporal memory and keyframe control matter for production workflows, but clip length remains short and quality claims are still Google-demonstrated. Adoption will hinge on whether consistency holds across multi-extend sequences, not the feature list.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這比較像可控性升級而非新旗艦：更長時序記憶與關鍵幀控制對製作流程有意義，但單段長度仍短，品質主張仍以 Google 示範為主。成敗取決於多次延伸後角色與鏡頭是否穩定，而非功能清單。
items_flat.quote: With Omni 1.1, the model can now analyze up to 10 seconds of prior context — a leap from previous models that only referenced the final second.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 Omni 1.1 中，模型現在能分析最多 10 秒的先前脈絡——先前模型只參考最後 1 秒。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind pilots double-blind evaluations for a proprietary Gemini model
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 啟動專有 Gemini 模型的雙盲評測試點
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said it is piloting what it calls the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model, using Google Cloud Confidential Space so evaluators cannot see Gemini weights and Google cannot see test prompts. Partners include the Singapore AI Safety Institute, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons; the pilot tests a Gemini Flash Lite model on confidential benchmarks. DeepMind published a technical report alongside the post.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布試點其所謂首個針對專有前沿級模型的雙盲評測，利用 Google Cloud Confidential Space，使評測方看不到 Gemini 權重、Google 也看不到測試提示。合作方包括新加坡 AI 安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 與 MLCommons；試點以 Gemini Flash Lite 對機密基準評測。DeepMind 同步發布技術報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The method targets a real integrity problem—benchmark contamination—but this is a pilot on Flash Lite, not a flagship, and independent reproducibility outside Google Cloud’s confidential compute stack is unproven. Whether other labs accept the same box will decide if this becomes industry practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 方法對準基準污染這個真實問題，但目前只是 Flash Lite 試點而非旗艦，且離開 Google Cloud 機密運算堆疊後的獨立可重現性尚未證實。其他實驗室是否接受同一套「黑箱」將決定這能否成為業界慣例。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary, frontier class AI model, which keeps external evaluations confined to a cryptographic “box” where they can’t be used by models later to optimize performance ahead of testing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天推出針對專有、前沿級 AI 模型的全球首個雙盲評測，把外部評測關在密碼學「盒子」裡，避免模型之後用這些題目預先優化表現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches commercial operations in Brazil
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在巴西啟動商業營運
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced commercial operations based in São Paulo, saying Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users, with about 215 million messages a day and nearly doubled users over the past year. It said Brazil ranks second globally by OpenAI API developers and is Codex’s largest Latin American market, with ChatGPT Enterprise seats up fivefold year over year. The post lists local partnerships including ITA, IMPA, HCFMUSP, ENTER, Estímulo, and a São Paulo city MOU.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布在聖保羅設立商業營運，稱巴西是 ChatGPT 週活躍用戶前三大市場之一，每日約 2.15 億則訊息、過去一年用戶近乎翻倍。官方稱巴西在 OpenAI API 開發者數量全球第二、是 Codex 拉美最大市場，ChatGPT Enterprise 席次年增五倍。文中列出與 ITA、IMPA、HCFMUSP、ENTER、Estímulo 及聖保羅市備忘錄等在地合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is market-buildout, not a model launch: OpenAI is converting already-high consumer usage into a local sales, education, and public-sector footprint. The GDP impact figure comes from an OpenAI-funded study, so the economic claim should be treated as advocacy-adjacent rather than independent proof.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是市場落地而非模型發表：OpenAI 要把既有高用量轉成在地銷售、教育與公部門據點。GDP 影響數字來自 OpenAI 資助研究，經濟主張應視為倡議性質，而非獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users. The number of users in the country has nearly doubled over the past year, and people in Brazil now send approximately 215 million messages to ChatGPT each day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 巴西是 ChatGPT 以週活躍用戶計的前三大市場之一。該國用戶數過去一年近乎翻倍，巴西使用者每天向 ChatGPT 發送約 2.15 億則訊息。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI study: ChatGPT plus critical-thinking training changes student work differently
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 研究：ChatGPT 與批判思考訓練對學生作業產生不同效果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a company study reporting that ChatGPT access improved the quality and coherence of students’ answers on a five-point rubric by almost a full point, while a causal-reasoning exercise led students to generate a wider range of unique ideas. Students who received both showed both effects. OpenAI framed the result as complementary: AI polished answers; the training broadened ideas.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布公司研究，稱取得 ChatGPT 後學生答案在五分量表上的品質與條理幾乎高出一分；因果推理練習則讓學生產出更廣、更獨特的想法。兩者皆接受的學生同時呈現兩種效果。OpenAI 將結果表述為互補：AI 讓答案更精煉，訓練讓想法更廣。
items_flat.analysis_en: The finding is useful as a product-education narrative, but it is an OpenAI-authored study, so independence and generalizability are limited until methods, sample, and task design are fully inspectable. It does not settle the broader debate on whether classroom AI use raises or lowers original thinking outside this setup.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 作為產品與教育敘事有參考價值，但這是 OpenAI 自家研究，在方法、樣本與題目設計可完整檢視前，獨立性與可推論範圍有限。它不能單獨了結課堂用 AI 究竟提升或削弱原創思考的更大爭論。
items_flat.quote: The takeaway: AI helped students make their answers better. Critical-thinking training helped make their ideas broader. The two play complementary roles in preparing students for the future.
items_flat.quote_zh: 重點是：AI 幫學生把答案做得更好；批判思考訓練幫他們把想法拓得更廣。兩者在為學生準備未來上扮演互補角色。

items_flat.title_en: Google and Khan Academy ship Gemini-built classroom tools for the new school year
items_flat.title_zh: Google 與 Khan Academy 推出 Gemini 課堂工具迎接新學年
items_flat.summary_en: Google said new Khanmigo features built with Gemini are launching for the school year: interactive diagrams that walk students through math and science concepts, and a teacher-controlled practice tool. Google.org engineers spent six months embedded with Khan Academy after an earlier grant and model-access partnership. Teachers can draft and validate questions with Gemini, upload their own materials, and review items before students see them.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 表示，以 Gemini 打造的 Khanmigo 新功能將於新學年上線：可帶學生走讀數理概念的互動圖解，以及由教師控管的練習工具。Google.org 工程師在先前資助與模型存取合作後，駐點 Khan Academy 六個月。教師可用 Gemini 起草並核對題目、上傳自有教材，並在學生看到前審核題組。
items_flat.analysis_en: The product change is teacher-gated practice plus visual tutoring, not an unconstrained student chatbot. Impact depends on classroom uptake and whether teacher review actually prevents low-quality or off-curriculum items at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 產品重點是教師把關的練習與視覺化輔導，而非放任的學生聊天機器人。實際影響取決於課堂採用率，以及教師審核能否在規模上擋住低品質或偏離課綱的題目。
items_flat.quote: Built with Gemini models, these updates bring new capabilities to Khanmigo, Khan Academy’s AI-powered student tutor and teaching assistant.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些更新以 Gemini 模型打造，為 Khan Academy 的 AI 學生導師與教學助理 Khanmigo 帶來新能力。
